versions.subject: Create new rules for T1502
versions.detection:
selection:
    EventID: 11
    TargetFilename|re:
        - '.*\\My Documents\\PowerShell\\(Microsoft\.)?.*(Profile|profile)\.ps1'
        - 'C\:\\Windows\\System32\\WindowsPowerShell\\v1\.0\\(Microsoft\.)?.*(Profile|profile)\.ps1'
condition: selection
versions.spl: | rex field=TargetFilename "(?<TargetFilenameMatch>.*\\\\My Documents\\\\PowerShell\\\\(Microsoft\\.)?.*(Profile|profile)\\.ps1)" | eval TargetFilenameCondition=if(isnotnull(TargetFilenameMatch), "true", "false") | rex field=TargetFilename "(?<TargetFilenameMatch2>C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\WindowsPowerShell\\\\v1\\.0\\\\(Microsoft\\.)?.*(Profile|profile)\\.ps1)" | eval TargetFilenameCondition2=if(isnotnull(TargetFilenameMatch2), "true", "false") | search EventID=11 TargetFilenameCondition="true" OR TargetFilenameCondition2="true"
